description: The members of a stock index (S&P 500, S&P 400, the Dow, Nasdaq 100, Russell 2000, MSCI EAFE, a Select Sector) with their weights: from the latest day's holdings State Street publishes (SPY, MDY, DIA, the sector SPDRs), or the N-PORT of an ETF that tracks the index, with the date, the number of members and how concentrated the top ten are. as_of gives the members on a past date from the ETF's N-PORT for that quarter, companies since removed included; changes_from lists who joined and who left between two dates.

as_of.description: A past date: the members as the tracking ETF's N-PORT reported them for the last quarter-end on or before it, companies since removed included, so a backtest's universe has no survivorship bias.

changes_from.description: An earlier date: also list the members added and removed between the report for it and the one used (as_of, or the latest).

index.description: An index by name ("S&P 500", "Nasdaq 100", "Russell 2000", "S&P 400", "MSCI EAFE", "Dow Jones"), or the ticker of an ETF that tracks the index you want (VOO, IWM, XLK).

limit.description: Most members to list, by weight; default 50.

source.description: daily (default where State Street publishes the fund's holdings each day: the S&P 500 through SPY, the S&P 400 through MDY, the Dow through DIA, the Select Sector SPDRs) or nport (the latest N-PORT, a quarter old).

name: index_constituents

outputSchema.description: rows are the index's members by weight (weights as fractions adding to 1).

title: Index constituents
